name: w11b-heart
about: Ported from the wave 11b live drivers (08-heart.mjs plain / marked / outside, 09-give.mjs) on a fresh scratch night at truth_1 with round 1 read: the server-room terminal (impersonate label “Terminal · Server Room”, terminal opened / closed), mark_for_reinstallation, the share of The Optical Drive, then the give of The Halifax Computer.

So what happens now? Can I keep talking to you?
